title: Diagonal and cocycle laws for compatible transport
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], U an etale T-scheme, Q a finite etale U-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], e an isomorphism identifying E restricted to U with the lifted Yoneda presheaf of Q, and t a natural section-compatible transport [def-weil-pbc-finite-local-model-compatible-transport]. For every scheme W, lift a: W → U, and Q-point x above a, t(a,a)(x)=x. For lifts a,b,c: W → U with equal composite to T, t(b,c)(t(a,b)(x))=t(a,c)(x).

from.place: Yoneda comparison, then diagonal and cocycle laws of local representatives

proof.text: For the diagonal, evaluate compatibility on the identity Q-point on Q (etale over T), using e inverse to obtain its section, then pull back along x by naturality. For the cocycle take R = Q ×_T U ×_T U, etale over T, with three universal lifts and its universal Q-point above the first lift. Applying e inverse gives a section s. Compatibility identifies successive transports with the Q-points associated to s under the second and third lifts, so the composite equals direct transport. Arbitrary (x,a,b,c) factor through R; naturality pulls back this equality. All constructions work for empty schemes by the same universal properties.

lean.statement: theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum_compatibility_transport (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (U : T.Etale) (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale) (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj) (t : FiniteLocalModelCompatibleTransport T E U Q e) : (∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (a : W ⟶ U.left) (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom), t.transport a a rfl x = x) ∧ (∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (a b c : W ⟶ U.left) (hab : a ≫ U.hom = b ≫ U.hom) (hbc : b ≫ U.hom = c ≫ U.hom) (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom), t.transport b c hbc (t.transport a b hab x) = t.transport a c (hab.trans hbc) x)
